for url in \\
  'https://highereducation.mp.gov.in/' \\
  'https://hed.mponline.gov.in/' \\
  'https://educationportal.mp.gov.in/' \\
  'https://www.mp.gov.in/' \\
  'https://collegedirectory.mp.gov.in/' \\
  'https://mponline.gov.in/Portal/Services/MPHigherEducation/'
do
  host="'$(printf '"'%s' \""'$url" | sed -E '"'s#https?://(["'^/]+).*#'"\\1#')

  rg -in -m 8 '"'higher education|college|directory|Shahdol|Abhyananda|Kalyanpur' \""'$file" || true
done'

base='https://highereducation.mp.gov.in/'
for spec in 'departments 1ugKXHpYig8XA1Gywhyocw%3D%3D' 'how-to-reach XSYTi9T5lJ0DZAllAH7tjw%3D%3D' 'new-course L357OI0HnQtAYLcN7EJK7Q%3D%3D' 'principal OH2JTjiwSYpTwsXKlKz86g%3D%3D'; do
  set -- "'$spec
  curl --insecure -L --fail --silent --show-error "${base}?page=$2&orgid=417" -o "$tmpdir/$1.html"
done
for f in departments how-to-reach new-course principal; do
  printf '"'%s\\n' \"--- "'$f ---"
  rg -in -C 2 '"'Abhyanand|अभयानंद|Kalyanpur|कल्याणपुर|Shahdol|शहडोल|Department|Course|Programme|परिचय|Sanskrit|संस्कृत|address|पता|Established|Established|No data' \""'$tmpdir/$f.html" | sed -n '"'1,220p' || true
done"
